about.lead: A closer look at our journey, direction, and the values we uphold.
profileBody: The company is a State-Owned Enterprise operating in a nationally strategic sector. We carry out business activities that support government policy while generating sustainable economic value.
Backed by professional people and an operational network across Indonesia, we are committed to applying the principles of good corporate governance in every aspect of our business.
mission: Provide quality products and services that benefit society.
Manage the business professionally, efficiently, and with a focus on sustainable growth.
Contribute to national development and the well-being of surrounding communities.
